fx_option_pricer_garman_kohlhagen.text:
`fx_forward_pricer` answers "what forward rate should apply to this currency pair, and what is an existing forward worth?" It takes `spot`, `rate_domestic`, `rate_foreign` and `tau`, and uses covered interest-rate parity to give the forward rate. If you pass `contracted_forward`, it also gives the mark-to-market value of a long-foreign position, scaled by `notional`.

`fx_option_pricer_garman_kohlhagen` answers "what is an FX option worth?" It adds a `strike`, a volatility `sigma` and an `option_type` of call or put. It is Black-Scholes with the foreign rate acting like a continuous dividend yield.

In short, the forward pricer deals with a fixed future exchange and needs no volatility. The option pricer values the right, but not the obligation, to exchange, so it depends on `sigma`.

explain.text: `fx_forward_pricer` (FX Forward Pricer) gives you an FX forward rate and, optionally, the mark-to-market value of a contract, using covered interest-rate parity. The forward is the spot rate (`spot`, domestic per one foreign unit) grown at the difference between the continuous domestic and foreign rates (`rate_domestic`, `rate_foreign`) over `tau` years to delivery. If you also pass a `contracted_forward`, it values a long-foreign position as `notional` times the gap between the forward and the contracted rate, discounted at the domestic rate. The value is in domestic currency, and `notional` is in foreign currency and defaults to 1.0.

when.text:
`fx_forward_pricer` (the FX Forward Pricer) fits when you need a forward FX rate or the value of an existing forward contract:

- You want the theoretical forward rate from spot and the domestic and foreign continuous rates, using covered interest-rate parity.
- You hold a contracted forward and want its mark-to-market value in domestic currency. Supply `contracted_forward` along with `notional` to get it for a long-foreign position.
- You want to see how different interest-rate gaps or times to delivery (`tau`) feed into the forward, since both are inputs.
- For pricing an FX option rather than a forward, `fx_option_pricer_garman_kohlhagen` is listed as a Garman-Kohlhagen FX option price.
